src/app/api/forms/revised-form-points-to.reason: The PR's own flag-off case. It never clears REVISED_FORM_POINTS_TO_NEWER_ENABLED itself; the ON arm sets it in the process env, and this is the first test in the file, so it sees the flag and gets the flag-on 409 ("expected 409 to be 500"). afterEach deletes the flag, so the second flag-off case (FORM_REVISIONS on) passes in both arms. The 409 it got is the intended ON behaviour.
